reason: Observed native PDF drops the source greater-than-or-equal glyph, turning >=7th parity into exact7th. Preserve the bound at paint time; do not change milk data or infer litres/year.
sourceLines: Tshupiso ya tlhahiso: 775.4–1073.4 kg milk/doe/305-day lactation. Lowest (≥7th parity) and highest (3rd parity) group means for milk yield per 305-day standardised lactation in 16,407 analysed South African ARC Saanen lactation records, 1955–2018, mostly intensive/semi-intensive stud herds. Original PDF Table 3 labels the last group ≥7th; HTML renders it >7th. Kept in kg, without litres conversion, annualisation or yield-by-age interpolation.

Tshupiso ya dilemo/mokgwa: South African Saanen reference by lactation number, not age in years: mean milk mass per standardised 305-day lactation was 947.3 kg at first parity, 1043.2 at second, 1073.4 at third, 1020.3 at fourth, 972.8 at fifth, 901.6 at sixth and 775.4 at ≥7th. These ARC milk-recorded groups were mostly intensive/semi-intensive stud herds. Record actual kidding date, lactation number and collected milk; do not divide these totals evenly into months.

Banana
Tse teng: 1; tse rerilweng: 1. Dihlahiswa: fruit (bunch of bananas).
Kakanyo ya palo: didikadikwe tse 2 tsa banana × dibanana tse 3 tse jetsweng. Mahlomela a latelang ha se difate tse
ding tse jetsweng.
Tshupiso ya kotulo ya pele: dikgwedi tse 13–20. KZN DARD e bolela ka ho hlaka nako ho tloha ho jaleng ho ya
kotulong le ho tloha kotulong ho ya kotulong. Dikgwedi di fetotswe ho ba dilemo (13/12 ho ya ho 20/12). Sena ha
se ponelopele e nang le letsatsi kapa nako ya kotulo ya selemo dikgweding tsohle. Nako ya nnete e itshetlehile ka
mofuta le tlhokomelo ya sebaka.
Annual plantation output: KZN plantation reference per year: conservative 20–25 t/ha, average 25–30 t/ha, good
40+ t/ha. This is annual area production; it is not the weight of one bunch or a measured age-yield curve for three
plants in a banana circle.
Cultivar, planting and crop cycle: The KZN guide gives 13–20 months for both the first planting-to-harvest cycle and
subsequent harvest-to-harvest cycles. It lists different commercial densities for Williams, Grand Nain and Chinese
Cavendish. A banana circle counts as three planted bananas here; replacement followers are stages of those mats,
not extra mapped trees or guaranteed year-round supply.
Ho hlokahala mofuthu, sebaka se se nang serame se qetellang ka leqhwa le metsi a tshepahalang. Boloka
lehlomela le tla nka sebaka ka mora ho tlosa kutu e behileng ditholwana.
Mofuta o nahannweng wa ho jala: Grand Nain bakeng sa sebaka se futhumetseng; sebedisa mefuta e meng
bakeng sa moya/serame e keletsong ya ho reka haeba maemo ao a le teng. Dikgwedi tsa kotulo tsa sebaka ha di
eso netefatswe.
Keletso ya ho reka: KZN e phodileng: Williams; dikgohlong tse futhumetseng: Grand Nain; lebopong le nang le
moya: Chinese Cavendish. Reka thepa ya ho jala e hlwekileng. Tsena ke dikgetho tsa maemo a lehodimo, ha se
dinako tsa pele/bohareng/morao.
Dibanana tse jewang di beha ditholwana ntle le ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya dipalesa.
Nako ya kotulo e lebeletsweng: ha ho mohlodi wa dikgwedi tse tsitsitseng tsa sebaka. Rekota matsatsi a ho jala le
kotulo sebakeng.

Avocado
Mofuta o hakanyeditsweng: Hass - ho lebelletswe ha di se di tiile


 Phe         Hlk          Hlb          Mme          Mot         Php          Phu          Pha         Leo          Mph          Pun          Tsh
Tse teng: 1; tse rerilweng: 1. Dihlahiswa: fruit.
Tshupiso ya kotulo ya pele: dilemo tse 2–3. Bruyns Hill, sehlopha sa bioclimatic sa Natal Midlands sa 2; Hass e
nosetswang kutung ya motso ya clone ya Duke 7, 7 x 7 m (difate tse 200/ha), e jadilweng ka 1982–1984. Pampiri e
tlaleha hore Hass e qalile nakong ya yona ya bobedi mme Fuerte ya qala nakong ya boraro. Tshupiso ya dilemo tse
pedi ho isa ho tse tharo e hlalosa mefuta eo ya teko, e seng avocado e nngwe le e nngwe kapa dilemo tsa ho qala
sethopong. Nako ya nnete e itshetlehile ka mofuta le tlhokomelo ya sebaka.
Tshupiso ya tlhahiso e tsitsitseng: dilemo tse 6–8. Tekong ena ya Natal Midlands e nosetswang le ho laolwa ka
matla, Hass e fihletse hoo e ka bang 20 t/ha dilemong tse 6 mme dirapa tsa atamela karolelano e phahameng ya
chai e ka bolokwang dilemong tse 8. Sena ke tshupiso ya ho beha e amanang le teko ena feela; ha ho boemo bo sa
nyoloheng ba naha kapa mothalo wa dilemo le chai o tlatswang ka boona dipakeng tsa dilemo.
Tshupiso ya tlhahiso: 100–112.5 kg/semela. Palo ya teko yona eo bongateng ba pele ba 200 trees/ha: 20,000 kg/ha /
200 = 100 kg/tree dilemong tse 6; karolelano e ka bolokwang 22,500 kg/ha / 200 = 112.5 kg/tree. Dilemong tse 3,
10,000 kg/ha / 200 = 50 kg/tree e le tekano. Tsena ke dipalo tsa tshupiso tse lekanang le karolelano bakeng sa
maemo a bitsitsweng a serapa sa Hass/Duke 7, ha se chai ya sefate ka seng e lekantsweng kapa tlhahiso e
nkelwang pele bakeng sa bongata bo fapaneng, mofuta, maemo a lehodimo kapa taolo. Ha ho hakanywe dilemo
tse pakeng.
Hass age benchmarks — irrigated Natal Midlands trial: Hass on Duke 7, initially 200 trees/ha at Bruyns Hill (Natal
Midlands bioclimatic group 2), with intensive irrigation and nutrition. Age 3: 10,000 kg/ha; age 6: 20,000 kg/ha;
sustainable average about 22,500 kg/ha. Same-study density permits equivalents of 50 kg/tree at age 3 and 100
kg/tree at age 6; there is no reference for every intermediate age. These orchard benchmarks are conditional on
good resources, comparable climate and timely orchard management, including Phytophthora control and
thinning; do not auto-fill farm quantities.
Boloka metso mobung o ntshang metsi hantle; metsi a bohlokwa nakong ya ho thunya.
Keletso ya ho reka: Tatellano ya KZN: Fuerte ya pele (Motsheanong–Pundungwane), Hass ya bohareng
(Phata–Tshitwe), Ryan ya morao (Pundungwane–Hlakola). Dinako tsena di a kopana. Reka difate tse
hlomathisitsweng tse nang le dileibole; netefatsa kutu ya motso le balekane ba ho tsamaisa peo.
Ho tsamaiswa ha peo ya dipalesa: e ka behang ditholwana ka karolo ka peo ya yona ya dipalesa. Hlahloba ditlhoko
tsa mofuta o kgethilweng le sebaka sa kgodiso ya dimela.
Mofuta o hakanyeditsweng: Hass. South Africa - warm subtropical regions (Hass cultivar). Mohlodi wa moralo ha
dimela di se di tsitsitse; netefatsa matsatsi a kotulo sebakeng. Ha ho bongata ba dijo kapa kotulo ya selemo sa pele
e tshepisitsweng.

SANBI describes humid coastal/estuarine conditions and no tolerance of even mild frost.

question before purchasing it as a household crop.

Tse teng: 1; tse rerilweng: 1. Dihlahiswa: Mahlaku le diphotlwa tse tala; boloka direkoto tsa tsona di arohane.
Tshupiso ya kotulo ya pele: dikgwedi tse 6–12. Tshupiso ya dikgwedi tse 6–12 e mabapi le kotulo ya pele ya
mahlaku ka mora ho jala. Dipalesa le diphotlwa hangata di hlahiswa selemong sa bobedi sa kgolo tataisong yona

Pod development, not a young green-pod picking calendar: This botanical description discusses pods that become
brown at maturity. The separate harvesting section requires young, tender, green pods for food and supplies no
calendar for that stage. March–April is retained as pod-development phenology, not a confirmed young-pod
picking season or leaf calendar.
Kgetha sebaka sa ho hola se nang le letsatsi se ntshang metsi hantle, sireletsa ho mela ha semela mme o rere ho
faola bakeng sa kotulo ya mahlaku.

e nang le mabitso le netefaditsweng sebakeng le nang le mohlodi; moralo ona ha o bolele hore semela se tlamella
nitrogen kapa se na le diphello tsa bongaka.
Nako ya kotulo e lebeletsweng: ha ho mohlodi wa dikgwedi tse tsitsitseng tsa sebaka. Rekota matsatsi a ho jala le
kotulo sebakeng.

Tse teng: 1; tse rerilweng: 1. Dihlahiswa: Nama ya ditholwana tse butswitseng feela.
Tshupiso ya kotulo ya pele: dilemo tse 3–5. Tlhahlobo e amahanya dilemo tsena tse 3–5 le thuto ya Avakoudjo et al.
naheng ya Benin, Afrika Bophirimela, e seng teko ya ho beha Afrika Borwa. Mokgwa wa ho atisa le maemo a
sebaka di lokela ho netefatswa pele e sebediswa sebakeng sa Afrika Borwa; ha se dilemo tse netefaditsweng
sebakeng seo kapa mothalo wa chai ho ya ka dilemo. Nako ya nnete e itshetlehile ka mofuta le tlhokomelo ya
sebaka.
Tshupiso ya tlhahiso: 40–100 kg/semela. Tlhahlobo e tlaleha 40–100 kg ka sefate se emeng ntle le nako ya selemo,
dilemo tsa ho hola ka botlalo, mofuta o nyalanang kapa maemo a tshimo a Afrika Borwa. Boloka boima ba pele ka
semela e le moelelo feela: o se ke wa bo bitsa kg/year, wa bo arola ka dikgwedi kapa wa bo nka e le ponelopele ya
polasi.
Harvest interval with unverified South African geography: The review states August–December but does not
identify a locality for that interval. Related monkey-orange literature discusses this interval in Zimbabwe and more
than one Strychnos species; it does not establish a South African spinosa picking calendar. The former South Africa
(general) window is withheld. Record the farm's own ripe-pulp months; seeds and unripe pulp are not ordinary
food.
Geography of the review's bearing-age citation: The 2021 review cites this Benin study for its 3–5-year bearing-age
statement. The cited source's geography is West Africa, not a South African orchard. Retain the review's numeric
statement with this condition; no local annual yield curve is supplied.
Dipeo le ditholwana tse sa butswang di na le tjhefo. Bana ba se ke ba kotula kapa ba lokisa ditholwana ba sa behwa
leihlo.
Keletso ya ho reka: Netefatsa boitsebiso le ho tshwara ka nepo pele o se kenya moralong wa dijo; ha ho mofuta o
bitsitsweng ka lebitso o nang le mohlodi.
Nako ya kotulo e lebeletsweng: ha ho mohlodi wa dikgwedi tse tsitsitseng tsa sebaka. Rekota matsatsi a ho jala le
kotulo sebakeng.

Dikgoho: Laying hens (commercial)
Meaho e 1 e teng; e 0 e sisintsweng. Kgwebo e kgethilweng: mahe. Ha ho nahannwe palo ya diphoofolo kapa
tlhahiso.
Keletso ya ho reka: bakeng sa tlhahiso ya mahe, kopa dikgoho tse nyane tse entilweng tse haufi le ho behela ho
mofani wa dikgoho tse behelang, ka direkoto tsa dilemo, phepo le ente.
Rera dijo tse leka-lekaneng, metsi a hlwekileng, moriti, moya le tshireletso ho dibatana. Phepelo ya mahe e
itshetlehile ka dinonyana tse behelang, dilemo tsa tsona, bophelo le tlhokomelo; hoko feela ha e fane ka mahe.
Bokella mahe kgafetsa, boloka moo dihlaha di alwang ho hlwekile ho omme, mme o tshware/boloke mahe ka
hloko bakeng sa tshebediso ya lelapa kapa thekiso.
Tshupiso ya nako: With a constant 14–16 hour light day, commercial hens keep laying at a high rate all year.
Tshupiso ena ya taolo ya kgwebo ha e bolele phepelo ya mahe ya lelapa e lekanang ka tlhaho.
Tshupiso ya sehlahiswa sa pele: dibeke tse 21. Dilemo tsa nonyana ho tloha ho qhotswa; netefatsa mofuta le
kgodiso le mofani. Dinonyana tse haufi le ho behela di qala hamorao potolohong ena.
Tshupiso ya tlhahiso: 407.1–428.6 eggs/hen housed, laying cycle to 90 weeks. Table 4a's cumulative 'Eggs/hen
housed' for five commercial strains; the same table gives 'Age at depop. weeks 90.0' for every strain. Commercial
barn/cage average, not a free-range smallholder trial. Kept as the source gives it: a per-year rate would need a
point-of-lay age from another document.
Tshupiso ya dilemo/mokgwa: SAPA 2024 commercial strain standards cumulative to 90 weeks: Dekalb Amberlink
429 eggs/hen housed, Dekalb Brown 428, Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, Hy-Line Brown 434 and Lohmann Brown Lite
413. These are full-cycle objectives, not eggs per calendar year or a smallholder forecast. Purchase age, actual
onset of lay, surviving laying hens, feed, water and lighting need separate records.
Hlahloba ditshupiso tse qaqileng tsa kgwebo bakeng sa dijo le bodulo. Bapisa dijo le sebaka le boemo ba phoofolo
le mokgwa wa bodulo; fana ka metsi a hlwekileng a tshepahalang.
In free-range systems, hens must have access to the outdoor range for at least 8 hours a day in daylight.
Where individual nest boxes are used, at least one nest for every 8 hens.
Hens need at least 8 hours of continuous darkness in every 24-hour cycle to rest properly.
Floor housing needs litter on at least a third (33%) of the floor.
The outdoor free-range area must not be overstocked: no more than 5 birds per square metre of range.
An owner or manager whose animals are, or may be, infected with a controlled animal disease must report it to the
state veterinary director immediately.
Newcastle disease and notifiable avian influenza are on the state list of controlled and notifiable animal diseases.
No animal may be slaughtered anywhere but an abattoir, with the exceptions below.
Slaughter for your own household, or for cultural or religious purposes, is exempt from the abattoir rule.

Dipodi: Dairy goat (Saanen / Toggenburg / British Alpine)
Meaho e 1 e teng; e 0 e sisintsweng. Kgwebo e kgethilweng: lebese. Ha ho nahannwe palo ya diphoofolo kapa
tlhahiso.
Keletso ya ho reka: bapisa mofuta/diphoofolo le sehlahiswa, dijo tsa sebaka, maemo a lehodimo le bokgoni ba
tlhokomelo; netefatsa le moeletsi wa sebaka wa mehlape kapa dinotshi.
Rera ho ya ka ho tswala ha nnete ha manamane/madinyane le nako ya lebese. Diphoofolo tse sa hlahiseng lebese
ha di fane ka lona.
Nako ya sehlahiswa sa pele: ha ho mohlodi bakeng sa kgwebo ena.
Tshupiso ya tlhahiso: 775.4–1073.4 kg milk/doe/305-day lactation. Lowest (7th parity) and highest (3rd parity)
group means for milk yield per 305-day standardised lactation in 16,407 analysed South African ARC Saanen
lactation records, 1955–2018, mostly intensive/semi-intensive stud herds. Original PDF Table 3 labels the last group
7th; HTML renders it >7th. Kept in kg, without litres conversion, annualisation or yield-by-age interpolation.
Tshupiso ya dilemo/mokgwa: South African Saanen reference by lactation number, not age in years: mean milk
mass per standardised 305-day lactation was 947.3 kg at first parity, 1043.2 at second, 1073.4 at third, 1020.3 at
fourth, 972.8 at fifth, 901.6 at sixth and 775.4 at 7th. These ARC milk-recorded groups were mostly
intensive/semi-intensive stud herds. Record actual kidding date, lactation number and collected milk; do not divide
these totals evenly into months.
Tshupiso ya dilemo/mokgwa: At Putukwane near Polokwane, 179 lactating does under extensive feeding with
irregular supplementation were observed for 210 days after kidding. Mean milk mass was 1.45 kg/day for Saanen,
0.75 for British Alpine and 0.56 for Toggenburg during observed lactation. Early lactation exceeded mid and late
lactation; March–April kidding outperformed October–November in this cohort. These conditions differ from
stud-herd records. Discuss adapted stock and feed locally; these are not litres/day or year-round promises.
Hlahloba ditshupiso tse qaqileng tsa kgwebo bakeng sa dijo le bodulo. Bapisa dijo le sebaka le boemo ba phoofolo
le mokgwa wa bodulo; fana ka metsi a hlwekileng a tshepahalang.
It is an offence to keep a goat somewhere with inadequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat, cold or
weather, or to confine/tether it in a way that causes unnecessary suffering.
It is an offence to starve, under-feed, or deny water or food to a goat.
An owner must not let a goat stay in a dirty or parasite-infested condition, and must get veterinary or other
treatment for a sick, injured or diseased animal when able to.
Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act: veterinary services
enforce isolation and movement restrictions, and a suspected case must be reported.
Inside a declared FMD-affected zone, goats and their products (including milk) cannot be moved into, out of, or
within the zone without a state veterinary movement permit and compliance with its conditions.
Every goat owner must register an official identification mark and mark their goats with it, under the Animal
Identification Act.
A goat may only be slaughtered for sale at a registered abattoir under the Meat Safety Act (relevant when culled
dairy does or male kids are sold for meat); slaughtering for the farmer's own consumption, or for cultural/religious
purposes, is exempt but that meat may not then be sold.
